a singleton's worktree-prune failure reaches both the tick result and the outcome envelope
acceptance: A singleton tick whose `pruneWorktrees` throws carries a ProvisionFailure on `TickResult.provisionFailures` and on the outcome envelope, whether or not worktree creation then succeeds.
notes: src/Dispatcher.ts:1846-1852 warns and continues; create (:1857) and setupWorktree (:1874) each build a record and return it on both surfaces. runFanout (:2387-2401) accumulates its prune throw into a wave-level array — same shape here, since a prune wall whose create succeeds must still ride the eventual result. Today a deterministic prune wall on a singleton-only chain repeats with the backstop blind.
